what: Hovering a dotted-underline link (3px line, 3px gap) clips the dots off to the right, then redraws them from the left (0.8s), while the right arrow is pushed 1rem outward (0.4s). On release only the arrow returns, in 0.25s

options.--fx-dur: Dashed line redraw duration (via style), default .8s
options.--fx-shift: Distance the arrow is pushed (via style), default 1rem
options.--fx-dash: Dash segments (line and gap, via style), default .3rem

note: Dotted line color follows the text color (currentColor). The link width is given by the user (the original is 24rem)

from.where: All pages .page-btn (dotted links for About, View list and View more, original .page-btn:before dashed-move-v2)
